name: mindmill
description: A per-project knowledge base of decisions, meeting notes, facts and architecture, kept as Markdown in a git repo. Sessions load the project's index at start, brief you on what is relevant to a task, record decisions you make (superseding old ones), and file meeting notes. Comes with Mindmill, a macOS app for browsing and editing.

kb_root.title: Knowledge base folder
kb_root.description: The folder holding kb.json and projects/. Leave empty to use ~/.config/kb/config.json, or ~/projects/knowledge.
